title.narrative: Drilling of 8 Solar-Powered Artesian Wells in Chad (Ouaddai, Sila, Wadi Fira, Batha East Regions)

description.narrative: Addressing the significant shortage of water fit for drinking and daily use, and reducing water- and hygiene-related diseases and deaths.
Drilling of 8 solar-powered artesian wells in Chad in the regions of Ouaddai, Sila, Wadi Fira and Batha East.

Provide safe drinking water; contribute to reducing water- and hygiene-related diseases and deaths; support the settlement of the indigenous population in targeted areas who lack access to safe drinking water.
Disbursement for "Drilling of 8 Solar-Powered Artesian Wells in Chad (Ouaddai, Sila, Wadi Fira, Batha East Regions)" in Chad, implemented by Education Development Organization in Chad
